text: こいつは　つかまりそうにないぞ！

structure.jp: つかまりそうにないぞ！

patterns.name: 〜そうにない
patterns.explanation: Verb stem + そうにない says it doesn't seem likely to happen. つかまりそうにない = 'doesn't look like it'll be caught'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, male-sounding emphasis. つかまりそうにないぞ = 'it doesn't look catchable, I tell you!'.
